dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: An active cut-off has not been done, except for the processes that are explicitly listed in the applicable PEFCR and that jointly contribute less than 1% to any of the 15 ILCD/EF impact categories, and less than 0.1% individually. Other omitted processes are considered to contribute less. All known flows of environmental relevance within the system boundary have otherwise been kept in the inventory. The system boundary is shown and described in the PEFCR for PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULES USED IN PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER SYSTEMS FOR ELECTRICITY GENERATION.
dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataSelectionAndCombinationPrinciples: The model is based on the information provided in the respective PEFCR and uses EF-compliant data sets wherever applicable and available. Data gaps have been closed using ILCD Data Network entry-level compliant or EF compliant data sets following the procedure in the PEFCR guidance 6.3. For selected processes in the foreground, for which no EF data sets are available, but where the inventory is provided in the PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULES USED IN PHOTOVOLTAIC POWER SYSTEMS FOR ELECTRICITY GENERATION PEFCR, the respective data sets have been built from that information. Data gaps have been closed according to the so-called data gap closing procedure that complements the PEFCR Guidance, with at least ILCD Data Network entry-level compliant data sets. LCI modeling is fully consistent. Energy and transport datasets from the PEF energy and transports tender are consistently used.
dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataTreatmentAndExtrapolationsPrinciples: In some cases, data gaps have been closed with data sets that represent a different than the intended geography (e.g. GLO, instead of EU-28+3); this is considered in the data quality rating.
dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.useAdviceForDataSet: This LCI result data set is the (market) representative product of the applicable PEFCR, developed in context of the European Commission’s Environmental Footprint pilot phase 2013-2018. This data set is modelled in compliance with the methodological requirements under the EF.

common:scope.name: LCI results or Partly terminated system

review.common:reviewDetails: The data set achieves an overall DQR of 1.9, under the EF scheme of the PEFCR Guidance 6.3. The dataset meets the requirements for an EF compliant data set, as specified in the referenced documents of the compliant system, i.e. PEFCR Guidance 6.3, and the applicable PEFCR. The foreground model is well representative of the depicted EU market of the reference flow, regarding both technological, geographical and time-related representativeness, while some relevant background data sets are less representative in these three aspects. The background data sets have moreover some limitations in terms of consistency, as they stem from different data providers without full consistency of the background system of those background data sets (aside from energy and transport data that are the same in foreground and across all background data); the use of these background data sets is however mandatory under the EF scheme. The completeness of elementary flows of the 16 EF impact categories is “Very good” for the foreground system and mostly “good” but often only “fair” for some parts of the background system. The LCIA result of the data set per reference flow is plausible. The data set documentation is appropriate in scope and detail, and correctly reflects the model (judged with samples), including meeting the permissible cut-off rules, LCI modelling provisions and (fully checked) system boundaries. Based on expert judgement, the uncertainty of the data set is sufficiently limited. The names, classes/categories of newly created flows and processes are ILCD compliant, otherwise exclusively the eligible ILCD reference elementary flows, flow properties and unit groups are being used, including the regionalisation of the large majority of the water and land use flow amounts.

common:commissionerAndGoal.common:intendedApplications: The data set is the documented and reviewed, aggregated LCI result of the representative product for the generation of electricity from photovoltaic of the applicable PEFCR. It can also be used as part of other product systems, where suitable, e.g. in PEF/OEF models or as a benchmark where appropriate.

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: The free use of the data set is granted, if as a minimum, the original source (see “permanent URI”) and the owner of the data set is be referenced when using the data set. The data set should not be used beyond the end of its “Valid until” year. Availability of potentially error-corrected and future versions of the data set can be identified via the “Permanent URI” and the responsibility to check for the availability of such versions rests with the data set user.
